article.title: Uso brasileño de esse frente a este
article.part: Pronombres y referencia pronominal — Pronomes e referência pronominal
article.chapter: Posesivos, demostrativos, indefinidos e interrogativos — Possessivos, demonstrativos, indefinidos e interrogativos

claims.summary: The traditional description distinguishes este/esta/isto from esse/essa/isso based on deictic relation.
In Brazilian Portuguese, esse/essa/isso has a much broader use and appears frequently where traditional grammar would allow or expect este/esta/isto.

In conversation, esse is commonly used for objects close to the speaker, even though traditional grammar would suggest este. The adverb 'aqui' clarifies location and reduces the need for strict opposition between the two demonstratives.
Examples include 'Esse livro aqui é meu.' and 'Isso que você disse é importante.', demonstrating the broader use of esse/isso in Brazilian Portuguese.
